game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs, stairs to a crypt: the ruin warden must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Matrix Map: Navigate a list of lists as rows and columns of a map.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs: stairs to a crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Crypt Stairs, repeat each round: Navigate a list of lists as rows and columns of a map. Each round, ghost knights strike the heart stone, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the map_cells value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the heart stone from ghost knights in Crypt Stairs: keep the map_cells meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: map_cells drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Matrix Map
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Matrix Map' (Week 7 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Crypt Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how map_cells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Crypt Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while map_cells > 0.
